Felix Pristine W5 — build the filed backlog (async flip · vix ceiling · LV telemetry · Part XI · ledger re-stamp)

Status: VERIFYING (Digest complete). 13 survey reports folded. A verify fleet of 7 is in flight before Decide cuts the plan. This wave does NOT re-audit the 12 closed domains — it SHIPS the filed backlog: each item its own opus slice / worktree / PR with a fail-before protective test and a green CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test. Heartbeat: wave_status = 'wave: verifying'.

The wish (verbatim intent)

• (1) async-flip part-2 — collect the wall-clock payoff Wave 4 left on the table. Flip ONLY files proven free of global mutable state. ETS rate-limiter tests + Application-env mutators STAY serial. Payoff measured = suite wall-clock before/after.
• (2) task-vix-bomb-explicit-ceiling — defense-in-depth explicit pixel/memory ceiling on the vix/libvips render path (twin of the Magick bound).
• (3) task-felix-liveview-telemetry-consumer — the Prometheus reporter consumes no LiveView mount/handle_event telemetry; wire the distribution metrics.
• (4) task-felix-part-xi-corpus-gap — close the Part XI coverage gap (Interop/Mailers/File-storage/i18n/Assets/GraphQL) with a per-concept verdict table under the improvement-only doctrine.
• (5) task-felix-ledger-restamp — re-stamp ~20 done-but-unstamped fix tasks with real merge-commit evidence (audit-trail rot; root cause task-6e819f39fe3aa9e6). NOT fabrication.
• SKIP task-felix-phantom-media-atomicity — Fable-class after-commit redesign, correctly parked; do NOT cut it into under-specified opus slices.

Direction for this wave

This is a SHIP wave, not an audit. The filed tasks already name their failure modes — the job is to build them green with fail-before proofs, in isolated worktrees, on opus (Fable exhausted this wave). The finished experience: the Felix backlog empties honestly — each closed task carries a PR, a merge commit, and a protective test that fails before the fix and passes after. Two of the five are code hardening (vix ceiling, LiveView telemetry), one is a measured performance collection (async flip), one is a bounded audit that produces its own verdict table (Part XI), and one is pure ledger hygiene (re-stamp) that restores trust in 'is X fixed?' answered via bp alone.

Leaning: sequence the async flip as the highest-effort slice (measurement + flake-hunt); treat vix-ceiling and liveview-telemetry as clean parallel opus slices with sharp fail-before tests; treat Part XI as a bounded audit whose only ship-deliverable is the verdict table + any qualifying child tasks (most chapters likely 'not-applicable' or 'already-good' — Barkpark has no Absinthe/GraphQL, and mailers/assets/i18n reach is small); treat ledger-restamp as a careful evidence-gathering pass, never a blind met:true stamp — each stamp must cite the actual merge commit.

The five slices → task map

• async flip part-2 → task-5a5e2c939a33a621 (in_progress; part-1 keystone landed; criteria 2-5 open). opus.
• vix ceiling → task-vix-bomb-explicit-ceiling (open). opus.
• LiveView telemetry → task-felix-liveview-telemetry-consumer (open). opus.
• Part XI corpus gap → task-felix-part-xi-corpus-gap (open, bounded audit). opus.
• ledger re-stamp → task-felix-ledger-restamp (open, bookkeeping). opus.
• Adjacent/optional: task-5dbbbe2efc44e48e (BokbasenLive paginate beyond @page_limit) — a Wave-4 follow-up; survey whether it belongs in this wave or stays backlog.

Survey plan (in flight — surveyors flying now)

Cast wide and cheap: map every seam the five slices touch so Digest can hand each opus builder a precise brief. Each assignment below names what to find and why it changes the plan.

1. async-safe test inventory: enumerate every test/**/*.exs with `async: false`, and flag which contain Application.put_env / :persistent_term / Registry. / Process.register / raw :ets new|insert|delete_all|delete_all_objects. Output the SAFE-to-flip list vs the MUST-stay-serial list. Why: this IS the flip's scope; a wrong flip flakes the suite.
2. rate-limiter keystone reality: confirm conncase.ex no longer does an unconditional :ets.delete_all_objects and that the bucket key is per-test scoped (commit bdf5db1d). Why: criterion 1 claims met:true — verify before flipping the ~160 ConnCase files it unblocks.
3. vix render path: map the vix/libvips rendition code (media rendition backend, where Vix.Vips / Operation is called, image decode entry). What resource controls Vix exposes (no ImageMagick -limit; likely a pre-decode dimension/pixel ceiling). Where the Magick twin bound landed (magick.ex) so the vix bound mirrors it. Why: defines the exact seam + test stub shape.
4. Prometheus/telemetry reporter: find the module defining prometheus_metrics/0 (Telemetry.Metrics distribution/counter definitions) and where Phoenix LiveView telemetry events would attach. List the exact event names Phoenix emits ([:phoenix,:live_view,:mount|:handle_event|:handle_params,:stop] + live_component). Why: names the metrics to add + how the driven-mount test asserts.
5. Part XI applicability scan: for each of Interop / Mailers / File-storage / i18n / Assets / GraphQL, does api/ even have it? (grep for Absinthe/absinthe, Swoosh/Mailer, gettext, esbuild/tailwind asset pipeline, file storage module, System.cmd/Port/NIF interop). Why: most chapters are likely not-applicable or already-good — bounds the audit sharply.
6. ledger re-stamp target list: enumerate the ~20 Felix child/related tasks that are lifecycle=done with criteria met:false or empty evidence; for each, find the merge commit/PR that actually landed the fix (git log / gh). Identify the 3 criteria-less Sobelow tasks and the 2 probe artifacts (task-bd2578a682eb6fce, task-fabbbbf10f60c17c). Why: the stamp must cite real evidence, never fabricate.

8. Elixir gate recipe in-worktree: confirm the borrow-warm-_build fast path (copy _build/test, symlink deps) works for a fresh Felix worktree, and that CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test runs (test.exs disables codelist seeder; registry self-call fixed a81e9761). Why: every slice needs a green gate; a broken borrow strands all five.

What is IN FLIGHT right now

• Digest complete — 13 surveys folded, corrections logged, 7-assignment verify fleet designed and appended above.
• Verify fleet FLYING now: V1-V7. Decide waits on their run-proofs before cutting the wave plan.
• Heartbeat stamped on epic task-96a908af98698118: wave_status = 'wave: verifying'.

Digest — what the survey established

Thirteen surveys, wide and shallow. The five slices are real, filed, unclaimed, and each names its failure mode. The load-bearing facts the build can stand on:

• ASYNC FLIP (task-5a5e2c939a33a621): the true split is 3-way, not 2-way. 443/788 test files are async:false; 277 pass the literal 5-pattern grep, but 47 of those still carry pattern-INVISIBLE shared state (System.put_env, Sandbox.mode, :meck, Bypass, start_supervised singletons, :telemetry.attach, shared uploads/ dir). The validated SAFE set is 230 files (prior stalled worker's /tmp/flip_final.txt — every one a subset of the independent 277). USE 230, NOT 277 — flipping the raw 277 silently reintroduces 47 flakes. The keystone rate-limiter scope fix (bdf5db1d) IS landed. No wall-clock baseline was ever captured; a fresh live gate run measured ~248s green off LOCAL (stale) main.
• VIX CEILING (task-vix-bomb-explicit-ceiling): seam fully mapped. Vix.render/4 = Image.open→thumbnail→watermark→write, in-process (no shell-out, so no Task.yield deadline needed). libvips has NO per-call -limit; its only knobs are process-global (cache_set_max_mem/1, concurrency_set/1). The per-request bound must be a PRE-thumbnail pixel-dimension guard using Image.width/height (cheap, pre-decode) returning a bounded {:error, :vix_...} tuple — a materially DIFFERENT mechanism than the Magick timeout twin. Magick precedent lives on origin/main (4ce8c471, #2868), NOT on local main.
• LV TELEMETRY (task-felix-liveview-telemetry-consumer): reporter = BarkparkWeb.Telemetry.prometheus_metrics/0, 8 metrics, ZERO LiveView. Exactly 4 event families to wire: live_view mount/handle_params/handle_event + live_component handle_event (NO live_component mount/handle_params event exists). Metadata carries a raw %Socket{} — needs a NEW tag_values fn to extract socket.view/component (no tag_values precedent in the repo). Protective-test template = write_hotpath_telemetry_test.exs's 3-tier declared/attached/fires-and-scrapes pattern.
• PART XI (task-felix-part-xi-corpus-gap): mostly not-applicable/already-good, as predicted. No Absinthe/GraphQL server anywhere (only the github plugin CONSUMES GitHub's GraphQL). Gettext installed but ZERO real call sites (3 hits, all self-referential moduledoc). Swoosh mailer mature + env-gated. Assets = 3 independent JS bundlers, not the stock esbuild/tailwind mix pipeline. Interop is the one live chapter — it already produced the wave-4 Magick fix and the wave-5 vix target. Deliverable is a per-concept verdict TABLE, not new digging.
• LEDGER RE-STAMP (task-felix-ledger-restamp): the count is 24, NOT the ~20/3 the task text claims — 18 done tasks with met:false + 6 with the acceptance_criteria field entirely ABSENT (only half are Sobelow). 22 of 24 resolve to a confirmed merge commit. Root cause task-6e819f39fe3aa9e6 does NOT block: the shape-mismatch defect is real but restamping already-done tasks is self-serve via /v1/data/mutate (no live claim/epoch, so close/stamp are the wrong tools regardless). Set REPLACES arrays wholesale (Writer.deep_merge) — a restamp patch must GET the full acceptance_criteria array, flip one entry, PATCH the whole array back.

Corrections & contradictions vs the wish

Where the survey diverges from the wish/direction text — these are what Decide must absorb:

• RESTAMP SCOPE is 24, not ~20/3. The wish's '~20 done-but-unstamped' and 'three criteria-less Sobelow tasks' both undercount. Decide must scope the slice to the full 24-task table (produced by the verify fleet).

Restamping it with a fabricated commit would violate the never-fabricate mandate. Must be resolved before the builder touches it (verify assignment V2).

Coverage map — checked & found / checked & NOT found

Distilled from the surveyors' coverage arrays. Absences are decisions-in-waiting.

The one risk the LEAD must know before merging the async flip

The full suite is NOT reliably 0-failures under the raised concurrency. Named failure mode: Barkpark.Repo.Migrations.ExtendWorkspaceDeleteCascadeTest (DataCase async:FALSE — untouched by the flip) runs raw DDL (ALTER TABLE apply_down → AccessExclusiveLock on the webhooks/synonyms tables) and hits a Postgrex 40P01 deadlock against a SPAWNED Barkpark.Webhooks.Dispatcher.audit_targets/1 SELECT (AccessShareLock) leaked from another test via Audit.safe_bridge → dispatch_audit_async (a fire-and-forget Task that escapes the sandbox owner and outlives its test). The flip does NOT touch the migration tests or the audit path, so it breaks nothing deterministically — but 55 more async files raises ambient concurrency and plausibly raises this flake's frequency. Both reviewer flakes self-healed on isolated --failed rerun.
